description: Screen-brief parity fixture: the design/ tree both implementations read plus the Go design_brief output for `login` (full depth). The Go half is pinned by pkg/design/brief_parity_test.go, which re-runs BuildScreenBrief over `tree` and fails on drift; the webui half is webui/src/components/design/screenBrief.parity.test.ts, which re-derives the brief client-side from the same bytes. If the Go pin fails after a brief.go change, re-derive goBrief over `tree` and update it — it is one deterministic JSON object, and the pin tells you the exact shape it must have.
